ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-ROTTING_SKULL.title: Rotting Skull
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-ROTTING_SKULL.descriptio: If your HP is at or below [blue]50%[/blue], gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional card at the start of your turn.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-ROTTING_SKULL.flavor: Find the other one too! Is this the beginning of a new collection?
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-TABASCO_SAUCE.title: Tabasco Sauce
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-TABASCO_SAUCE.descriptio: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. Healing effects are reduced by [blue]50%[/blue].
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-TABASCO_SAUCE.flavor: Ah, that's hot! That is hot!
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-HIGH_HEELS.title: High Heels
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-HIGH_HEELS.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. At the start of combat, lose [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] and shuffle [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [red]Clumsy[/red] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-HIGH_HEELS.flavor: Elegant, but not very comfortable for combat.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-POGO_STICK.title: Pogo Stick
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-POGO_STICK.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. Whenever you trigger [gold]Sly[/gold], shuffle [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [red]Dazed[/red] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-OLD_T_V.title: Old TV
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-OLD_T_V.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. At the start of combat, shuffle [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [red]Reception Problems[/red] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-OLD_T_V.flavor: Too old to use, too good to throw away.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-AGGRESSION_PROTOCOL.desc: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. Attacks must be played before other cards.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-AGGRESSION_PROTOCOL.flav: Prioritization updated: Violence first, questions later.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-FADING_CONSTELLATION.des: At the start of your turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and lose {Stars:starIcons()}.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-FADING_CONSTELLATION.fla: The constellations fade, but you press on.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-ROYAL_COFFERS.title: Royal Coffers
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-ROYAL_COFFERS.descriptio: If you have at least [blue]{Gold}[/blue] unspent [gold]Gold[/gold], gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-ROYAL_COFFERS.flavor: Money doesn't buy happiness. Just energy.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-BRASS_COIL.title: Brass Coil
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-BRASS_COIL.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. Enemies start combat with [blue]{ArtifactPower}[/blue] [gold]Artifact[/gold]. In single-enemy combats, the enemy gains [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Artifact[/gold] instead.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-NECROTIC_SCYTHE.title: Necrotic Scythe
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-NECROTIC_SCYTHE.descript: The first time each turn you play a card that costs {EnergyThreshold:energyIcons()} or more, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-RED_ROSE.title: Red Rose
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-RED_ROSE.description: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your turn. ALL enemies start combat with [blue]{ThornsPower}[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold].
ENERGIZEDSPIRE2-RED_ROSE.flavor: There is no rose without a thorn.
